description.p: XXERipper is a standalone black-box XXE scanner that combines in-band, error-based, and blind out-of-band detection techniques with statistical baselining, differential parser fingerprinting, and manual out-of-band confirmation via interactsh-client.
Every finding is mapped to one or more CWE identifiers, and the scanner can emit SARIF v2.1.0 for CI/CD integration with GitHub code scanning, GitLab SAST, and Azure DevOps.

ul.li: 30+ attack technique families across six classes
Manual and Automatic OOB confirmation with per-technique callback labels
Statistical baseline with IQR + entropy analysis
Differential parser fingerprinting across 11 XML stacks
Multi-indicator file and cloud metadata fingerprinting
Content-Type, HTTP method, and query-parameter delivery vectors
Per-phase exception isolation for stability on flaky targets
CWE-mapped findings (CWE-611, CWE-200, CWE-918, CWE-78, CWE-776)
SARIF v2.1.0 output and CI exit-code gating
Custom payload injection with placeholder substitution
Burp request ingestion with automatic cookie extraction
HTTP/2 negotiation with HTTP/1.1 fallback
Universal extraction with paste-ready credential snippets
Multi-stage exploit chain rollup detection
XSLT-in-Office and YAML deserialization probes
